server.description: Burp server host and port in the form host:port

cname.description: Client name (common name) used in backups

server_can_restore.description: Allow the server to initiate restores (0=off, 1=on)

cross_filesystem.description: Mount point(s) across which file system boundaries should be crossed during backup

cross_all_filesystems.description: Whether to cross all filesystem boundaries (0=no, 1=yes)

ssl_cert_ca.description: Path to SSL CA certificate file

ssl_cert.description: Path to client SSL certificate file

ssl_key.description: Path to client SSL private key file

ssl_peer_cn.description: Common name expected in the server's certificate

include_path.description: Top-level directory or file to include in backups
